standout_why: Reviewed.com (CITED, 2026-11-06) lists subscription prices for each feeder, such as Birdbuddy auto ID at $98.99 a year and Harymor at $49.99 or $69.99 a year. It never totals hardware plus plan over any period. It does not cover the Birdfy Cam 2 or the Wasserstein case, and it mentions Wasserstein only by name. WIRED (CITED) could not be fetched (the fetch tool can't reach wired.com), so I couldn't check it. ChatGPT's own answer gives the Wasserstein case at $69.99 with 'camera sold separately' but never mentions that the Blink camera needs a paid plan to keep clips.
decides: This confirms the Birdfy Cam 2K or 2 4K as the pick for 'a camera for a feeder you already own'. Blink Basic alone costs $119.97 over three years. That is more than a Cam 2 4K costs outright, before you add the case and the camera, and the Wasserstein route still has no bird ID. Buy the Wasserstein case only if you already own a compatible Blink, Wyze or Ring camera and already pay for its plan.
